core_categories: Medical Consumables and Devices; Diagnostic and Monitoring Equipment; Emergency and Resuscitation Gear; Anesthesiology and Respiratory Items; Endoscopy Solutions; Home Healthcare Tools; Aesthetic Medical Devices
specialty_focus: Medisource Supply (Asia) is a Hong Kong-based medical device distributor and supplier established in 2003. It distributes medical equipment, consumables, and healthcare products to hospitals, private clinics, associations, and non-profit organizations. The company focuses on high-acuity clinical fields such as emergency medicine, critical care, and ultrasound diagnostics, and provides after-sales technical support, product servicing, and clinical training. It does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
